newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SAKU TO RELEASE Q1 RESULTS ON JUNE 5.
newsitem.headline: SAKU TO RELEASE Q1 RESULTS ON JUNE 5.

text.p: Saku brewery said on Wednesday that it will release its first quarter results on June 5.

In statement the company, which was facing suspension for not releasing its first quarter results, said that the company's board decided according to meet bourse requirments to release the first three months results on June 5.
June 5 was the deadline set by the stock exchnage for free market listed companies to provide their first quarter results.
Saku brewery was the only company to not have provided its results to date.
